reason: Both correctly land on overheat protection from restricted ventilation after the new drawer, but Conversation 1 stays honest and tight: no part suggested, clear engineer escalation, and it respects the homeowner's refusal without inventing more work. Conversation 1's second turn is lazy in not naming the fitter/installer to check clearances, which keeps the margin slight.
